metadata.title: Client & Program Goals
metadata.purpose: Reference file for fitness programming and Claude Code integration

instructions_for_claude.step_1: Identify Primary Goal and select its mapped_program_file
instructions_for_claude.step_2: Identify Secondary Goals and layer modifications on top
instructions_for_claude.step_3: Check for contraindications and cross-reference injury_navigation.json if applicable
instructions_for_claude.step_4: Confirm population type and apply population-specific rules (prenatal, postpartum, active_aging)
instructions_for_claude.step_5: Output program structured by session, week, and phase

primary_goals.name: Fat Loss
primary_goals.definition: Reducing overall body fat percentage while preserving as much lean muscle as possible

primary_goals.name: Muscle Growth (Hypertrophy)
primary_goals.definition: Increasing muscle size through progressive overload and sufficient volume

primary_goals.name: Body Recomposition
primary_goals.definition: Simultaneously reducing body fat and building lean muscle — typically for intermediate+ clients
programming_priorities: Balanced fat loss and hypertrophy stimulus

primary_goals.name: Strength & Power
primary_goals.definition: Maximizing force production for maximal strength or explosive power output

primary_goals.name: Athletic Performance
primary_goals.definition: Improving sport-specific physical qualities — speed, agility, power, coordination, endurance
primary_goals.rest_periods: Full recovery for power/speed; short for conditioning

primary_goals.name: Cardio & Endurance
primary_goals.definition: Building aerobic capacity, cardiovascular efficiency, and stamina for sustained effort
primary_goals.rest_periods: Active or full depending on zone

primary_goals.name: Functional Fitness
primary_goals.definition: Improving movement quality, coordination, and strength for real-life tasks and daily activities

primary_goals.name: Postpartum Recovery & Enhancement
primary_goals.definition: Supporting the physical recovery and return to training after childbirth
special_considerations: Always confirm medical clearance before programming
Flag any symptoms (leaking, prolapse, pain) — refer out immediately
Do not progress load until foundational core and pelvic floor are established

primary_goals.name: Active Aging
primary_goals.definition: Maintaining and improving strength, mobility, balance, and independence for clients 55+

primary_goals.name: Mind-Body Integration
primary_goals.definition: Training that emphasizes the connection between mental and physical wellness — breathwork, mobility, mindfulness in movement

primary_goals.name: Prenatal Fitness
primary_goals.definition: Safe, trimester-aware exercise programming for pregnant clients
programming_priorities: Baby and mother safety above all
special_considerations: Always confirm OB clearance before programming
Avoid supine position after first trimester

secondary_goals.name: Injury Navigation
secondary_goals.description: Client has a current or past injury limiting movement
secondary_goals.programming_impact: Modify exercises, avoid loaded ranges, cross-reference injury_navigation.json

secondary_goals.name: Mobility & Flexibility
secondary_goals.description: Client wants to improve range of motion
secondary_goals.programming_impact: Add warm-up and cooldown mobility work, prioritize joint prep

secondary_goals.name: Stress & Recovery
secondary_goals.programming_impact: Reduce intensity, prioritize parasympathetic training, shorter sessions

secondary_goals.name: Confidence Building
secondary_goals.description: New to training, needs wins and momentum
secondary_goals.programming_impact: Lower complexity, higher success rate exercises, celebrate progression

secondary_goals.name: Competition Prep
secondary_goals.description: Client is preparing for an event or competition
secondary_goals.programming_impact: Peak programming, taper planning, sport-specific final phase

secondary_goals.name: Weight Maintenance
secondary_goals.description: Client is at goal weight and wants to sustain
secondary_goals.programming_impact: Balanced stimulus, no aggressive cut or bulk

secondary_goals.name: Postural Correction
secondary_goals.description: Client has imbalances such as anterior pelvic tilt or rounded shoulders
